byline_constraint: BOTWAVEBOMBA byline = project handle or operator's legal name. No Al Gringo / no gringo1904 byline on any public surface.
thesis: Track all money from AIPAC and other pro-Israel superdonors to expose how the 2-party system is funded by one aligned cluster whose interests do not match the American working class.
substrate_definition: All pro-Israel PACs + their top 50 individual donors. Money trail: Donor -> Lobbyist -> Congress -> Agency -> Rule -> Contract.
primary_source_policy: Every URL must be primary-source: fec.gov, opensecrets.org, congress.gov, senate.gov (LDA), courtlistener.com, or the agency's own FOIA portal. No inference as fact.

tier1_pacs.name: American Israel Public Affairs Committee (AIPAC)
tier1_pacs.notes: Operates the United Democracy Project (UDP) super-PAC. Largest single-issue lobby in US politics. Reported $100M+ independent expenditures in 2024 cycle (OpenSecrets, 2024 cycle summary).

tier1_pacs.name: United Democracy Project (UDP)
tier1_pacs.notes: AIPAC's independent-expenditure arm. Spent $25M+ to primary Rep. Donna Shalala-equivalent races and unseating progressives in 2022 + 2024 (e.g. Jamaal Bowman, Cori Bush, Andy Levin).

tier1_pacs.name: J Street
tier1_pacs.notes: Liberal pro-Israel, pro-two-state-solution. Endorses Democrats almost exclusively.

tier1_pacs.name: Democratic Majority for Israel (DMFI)
tier1_pacs.notes: Pro-Israel centrist Democratic PAC. Spent heavily against the progressive 'Squad' in 2020, 2022, 2024 primaries.

tier1_pacs.name: Republican Jewish Coalition (RJC) PAC
tier1_pacs.notes: Republican-aligned pro-Israel PAC. Heavy Republican House + Senate donors; active in GOP primaries.

tier1_pacs.name: Zionist Organization of America (ZOA)
tier1_pacs.notes: Hawkish. Mort Klein leadership. Not a registered federal PAC; lobbying expenditures filed under 501(c) arm.

top_donors_template.name: <TBD>
top_donors_template.provenance: IRS Form 990 Schedule C / ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer

tier1_pacs.name: Americans for a Safe Israel (AFSI)
tier1_pacs.notes: Right-wing. Historically hawkish on settlements. Smaller dollar volume than AIPAC family but consistent on settlements + UN criticism.

tier1_pacs.name: Foundation for Defense of Democracies (FDD)
tier1_pacs.notes: Hawkish neoconservative think tank. Many former alumni in Trump admin (Amb. John Bolton, Ric Grenell, Mark Dubowitz). Registered lobbying arm FDD Action runs lobbying disclosures.

tier1_pacs.name: Hadar / Hadassah
tier1_pacs.notes: Major Jewish-American women's org. Non-PAC. Engages in advocacy through 501(c) arm + coalitions.

tier1_pacs.name: Birthright Israel Foundation
tier1_pacs.notes: Funds free Israel trips for young Jewish adults. Sheldon Adelson + Michael Steinhardt were founding mega-donors.

tier1_pacs.name: Maccabee Task Force
tier1_pacs.notes: Founded by former AIPAC staff. Focuses on social-media narrative warfare on college campuses + primaries.

tier1_pacs.name: Israel Policy Forum (IPF)
tier1_pacs.notes: Centrist, pro-two-state. Smaller dollar volume. Coordinates with J Street on policy.

tier1_pacs.name: Development Corporation for Israel (Israel Bonds)
tier1_pacs.notes: Official issuer of Israel government bonds in the US. Lobbying arm: DCI Group / Israel Bonds lobbying filings via Senate LDA. Not a PAC.

top_donors_template.name: <TBD>
top_donors_template.provenance: Senate LDA lookup: https://lda.senate.gov/filings/public/ (registrant: 'Development Corp for Israel')

tier1_pacs.name: Washington Institute for Near East Policy (WINEP)
tier1_pacs.notes: Founded by Martin Indyk with AIPAC support. Many former alumni in State Dept + NSC.

tier1_pacs.name: Middle East Forum / Middle East Forum Advocacy
tier1_pacs.notes: Daniel Pipes. Hosts CampusWatch, IslamistWatch. Operates Israel Victory Project. Hawks vs. Iran-deal + BDS.

tier1_pacs.name: EMET Endowment for Middle East Truth
tier1_pacs.notes: Hawkish. Runs the 'Emerging Threats' caucus briefings on Capitol Hill. Small dollar but high-access.

tier1_pacs.name: Christians United for Israel (CUFI)
tier1_pacs.notes: Pastor John Hagee. 10M+ members. Largest Christian-Zionist org. CUFI on Campus is the university pipeline. Confirmed by OpenSecrets: $3-4M per cycle direct to candidates.

tier1_pacs.name: NORPAC
tier1_pacs.notes: NJ-based bipartisan. Annual mission trips to DC for superdonors to meet with Congress. Closely aligned with AIPAC on legislative priorities.

This file is additive: api/corruption.json (v1, 307 rows CA Governor race) is preserved unchanged.
render_route: When schema_version === 2 (or file ends with 'corruption_v2.json'), corruption.js renders the Tier 1 PAC grid (top) + the 20-row money-trail table (below) with sortable columns: donor -> lobbyist -> congress -> bill -> vote. When schema_version is missing/1, render the existing v1 cards + table.
